## Question 3

The Be Fit Health Club offers two different payment plans.
Plan A has an initial fee of 400 zeds and a weekly fee of 25 zeds.
Plan B does not have an initial fee but has a weekly fee of 50 zeds.

The figure below compares the cost for Plan A and Plan B.

[Image: Be Fit Health Club Payment Plans graph]

C. At 24 weeks, what is the difference in total cost between the two plans?

output.answer_1: The dashed line starts at the origin (0, 0) and has a slope of 50 zeds per week, so it represents Plan B (no initial fee, 50 zeds per week). The solid line starts at 400 zeds at week 0 and rises 25 zeds per week, so it represents Plan A (initial fee 400, 25 zeds per week). Label the box at the end of the dashed line "Plan B" and the box at the end of the solid line "Plan A".
output.answer_2: Plan A cost = 400 + 25w and Plan B cost = 50w. Setting them equal: 400 + 25w = 50w, so 400 = 25w, giving w = 16. At week 16 both plans cost 800 zeds (the lines intersect at (16, 800)). So you would have paid the same amount at week 16.
output.answer_3: At 24 weeks, Plan A costs 400 + 25(24) = 400 + 600 = 1000 zeds, and Plan B costs 50(24) = 1200 zeds. The difference is 1200 - 1000 = 200 zeds. Plan B costs 200 zeds more than Plan A at 24 weeks.
